title: MASCRDM: Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation in Training Process of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied in various fields. However, ensuring compliance and safety of LLMs, such as avoiding discrimination and bias, still remains a challenge. Current efforts mainly focus on detecting and filtering inputs and outputs of the trained models, rather than studying the intrinsic architecture of the models in real-time. To tackle this challenge, we analyze the LLMs training process and discover two critical issues: 1) Most of the existing methods are predominantly static in their approach to detection and filtering, achieving only localized optimizations without systematically enhancing the compliance of LLMs. 2) Another issue with existing approaches is the lack of real-time risk detection and mitigation across the full training process, which leads to limited flexibility. translated_title: MASCRDM：用于大语言模型训练过程中合规风险检测与缓解的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已被应用于各个领域。然而，确保大语言模型的合规性与安全性（例如避免歧视和偏见）仍然是一项挑战。当前的努力主要集中在检测和过滤已训练模型的输入与输出上，而非实时研究模型的内在架构。为了应对这一挑战，我们分析大语言模型的训练过程并发现了两个关键问题：1）大多数现有方法在检测和过滤方面主要采用静态方式，仅实现局部优化，而未能系统性提升大语言模型的合规性；2）现有方法的另一个问题是缺乏贯穿整个训练过程的实时风险检测与缓解机制，导致灵活性受限。受此启发，我们提出了MASCRDM（用于合规风险检测与缓解的多智能体系统），应用于大语言模型的训练过程中。
tldr: 提出MASCRDM多智能体系统，在大语言模型的完整训练过程中实现实时合规风险检测与缓解，突破了现有静态输入输出过滤方法仅能局部优化的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MASCRDM, a multi-agent system that provides real-time compliance risk detection and mitigation throughout the entire LLM training process, overcoming the limitations of existing static input-output filtering approaches.
